latest_release.name: v0.20.0
latest_release.body:
Jellyfin for Android TV 0.20 is here! This release brings redesigned settings, improved video playback and subtitle support, better integration with external players, and plenty of enhancements across the app. Read about the highlights in our [blog post](https://jellyfin.org/posts/androidtv-v0.20.0/) or explore the full changelog below.

If you appreciate my work, you can show your support with a [donation through Buy Me a Coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/nielsvanvelzen) or [GitHub sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/nielsvanvelzen). Your support helps me continue improving and growing the app. Thank you!

## 🌟 Highlights

- Add option to always burn in subtitles when transcoding #4459, by [@GertSallaerts](https://github.com/GertSallaerts)
- Require Android 6 at minimum \(API 23\) #4836, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)
- Use Jellyfin 10\.11 based SDK #5037, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)
- Support Advanced SubStation Alpha direct play #5121, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)
- Add new settings UI #5198, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)
- Allow selecting external video player app #5280, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)
- Add user\-defined AVC/HEVC codec level override #5520, by [@johnpc](https://github.com/johnpc)
- Add photo player presentation delay to settings as user preference #5722, by [@hraabis](https://github.com/hraabis)
- Add user preferences to force enable or disable common HDR formats #5743, by [@clowncracker](https://github.com/clowncracker)

## 💥 Crash fixes

- Use android plugin for AboutLibraries generation #5206, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)
- Fix missing focus in new player UI #5513, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)
- Fix NullPointerException when display\.getHdrCapabilities\(\) returns null #5718, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)
- Fix Live TV guide crash when channel loading fails #5801, by [@andrew749](https://github.com/andrew749)
- Use strong reference to licenses resource #5809, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)
- Fix crash when mirroring libraries and collection folders using remote control #5829, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)
- Fix crash when returning to Home while a video is playing #5841, by [@HaraldNordgren](https://github.com/HaraldNordgren)
- Add additional null checks to PlaybackController\.findBestDisplayMode #5882, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)

## 🔧 Bugfixes

- Remove redundant TargetApi annotations #5142, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)
- Fix range control calculation when minimum is not 0 #5263, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)
- Remove value override from RangeControl #5264, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)
- Don't overwrite displayPreferencesId in ItemRowAdapterHelper\.retrieveUserViews #5296, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)
- Fix rememberPreference not saving for AsyncPreferenceStore #5297, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)
- Use DialogBase for InAppScreensaver #5305, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)
- Fix initial focus on visibility change in DialogBase #5306, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)
- Remove drop shadows from BrowseGridFragment #5370, by [@TheMejmun](https://github.com/TheMejmun)
- Correct video start delay setting not showing decimal values in settings #5376, by [@JagerSprinkles](https://github.com/JagerSprinkles)
- Fix non\-enum preferences not persisting to server #5406, by [@skalthoff](https://github.com/skalthoff)
- Fix dismissing in\-app screensaver with remote #5493, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)
- Change heading from 'Refresh Switching' to 'Resume Preroll' #5498, by [@bin101](https:/

detail.readme:
Jellyfin for Android TV

Part of the Jellyfin Project

---






Download archive

Jellyfin for Android TV is a Jellyfin client for Android TV, Nvidia Shield, and Amazon Fire TV devices. We welcome all contributions and pull requests! If you have a larger feature in mind please open an issue so we can discuss the implementation before you start. ## Building The app uses Gradle and requires the Android SDK. We recommend using Android Studio, which includes all required dependencies, for development and building. For manual building without Android Studio make sure a compatible JDK and Android SDK are installed and in your PATH, then use the Gradle wrapper (`./gradlew`) to build the project with the `assembleDebug` Gradle task to generate an apk file: ```shell ./gradlew assembleDebug ``` The task will create an APK file in the `/app/build/outputs/apk/debug` directory. This APK file uses a different app-id from our stable builds and can be manually installed to your device. ## Branching The `master` branch is the primary development branch and the target for all pull requests. It is **unstable** and may contain breaking changes or unresolved bugs. For production deployments and forks, always use the latest `release-x.y.z` branch. Do not base production work or long-lived forks on `master`. Release branches are created at the start of a beta cycle and are kept up to date with each published release. Maintainers will cherry-pick selected changes into release branches as needed for backports. These branches are reused for subsequent patch releases. ## Translating Translations can be improved very easily from our [Weblate](https://translate.jellyfin.org/projects/jellyfin-android/jellyfin-androidtv) instance. Look through the following graphic to see if your native language could use some work! We cannot accept changes to translation files via pull requests.
